sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Abrar Ahmad Siddiqui Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

This Application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to direct the court below to hear and decide the Case No. 200 of 2021 (State vs. Ankit Mishra and another) under Sections 498A, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Colonelganj, District Allahabad pending before A.C.J.(J.D.), court no. 21, Allahabad expeditiously within stipulated time.

entities.text: Case No. 200 of 2021 (State vs. Ankit Mishra and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant states that cognizance was taken on 3.9.2021 and accused were summoned; charges were framed on 4.6.2022; case is fixed for evidence; ;witnesses appeared on many dates but their statements have not been recorded, hence, a direction may be issued to the court below to the decide the same expeditiously.
It is directed that court below shall make all endeavour to decide this case expeditiously preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of the order, without permitting undue adjournments to either side, if there is no legal impediment.
